title: Velaris
description: Velaris is a blue themed texturepack with the focus on pvp and QoL.
body:
## Glaze:

This is by far one of my favourite packs!
Its focus is on PVP and some QoL features.

## ❓What is in this Tp?
- Cleaner textures (Mace,dirt,netherack,etc.)
- PVP (Animated enderpearl,small Gap,Clean sword,outlined cobweb,no fishing bober,etc.)
- Enviroment (clean water,less rain,round sun and moon,better grass,costum sky,etc.)
- Particles (clean particles,pvp particles are small and blue)
- Sounds (sounds for shield brake and totem pop)

## 🌤️Sky:
- Why is the sky not working?
 _You need the mod Skyboxify for that!_

## 🥺 Still need help?
- Join my discord and open a ticket! https://discord.gg/bvybvrtP2d
